data.title: 'I couldn't breathe', Russell Brand's alleged rape victim says
data.description: LONDON - A woman allegedly raped by British comedian Russell Brand more than two decades ago has recalled how she was left scared and "felt dirty" after being attacked in her hotel room.

data.title: Pope's cancer operation already reshaping papacy
data.description: ROME - With Pope Leo XIV recovering in hospital on Thursday following his lung cancer operation, questions are swirling about how the illness could change his papacy, less than two years after his election.

data.title: ONE Championship: Prajanchai makes weight for Wang clash as Aliff waits
data.description: Prajanchai Pongsuphan PK cleared the scales for his first ONE Championship fight in more than a year on Thursday, setting up a kickboxing comeback he hopes will prepare him for a long-awaited Muay Thai title unification bout with Aliff Sor Dechapan.

data.title: Zelensky defies Trump with Russian refinery strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Ukraine will no longer abide by US President Donald Trump's demands not to strike Russian oil refineries, President Volodymyr Zelensky said in remarks published Thursday, amid deepening tensions between the two leaders over a US-Russia diesel agreement.

data.title: Upper House’s first Bangkok residences ready for viewing

data.title: Can a Shot of Ginger Change Your Morals? A Monk on Awareness and the Body

data.title: Internet cable found between border house and Myanmar casino
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Authorities found an internet cable illegally laid from a border house in Sangkhla Buri district to a possible casino in Myanmar on Thursday.

data.title: Embattled Albanian PM tours protest aftermath
data.description: TIRANA , Albania - Protesters and police clashed in Albania's capital for a third straight day on Thursday, when the prime minister toured the aftermath of demonstrations that left government buildings badly damaged.

data.title: ‘No place to breathe’: life in Indonesia’s fire epicentre
data.description: PALANGKARAYA, Indonesia - Irvan Maulana has struggled with shortness of breath and a cough as wildfire smoke cloaks the Indonesian city of Palangkaraya in West Kalimantan. But he is a doctor, and patients keep arriving.

data.title: Media experts urge safeguards for Thai PBS
data.description: Replacing earmarked tax funding with annual government budget allocations for Thai PBS could expose the public broadcaster to greater political influence, say media academics, who have called for stronger financial transparency and more diverse revenue sources.

data.title: Seafood savours at InterContinental Bangkok
data.description: You don't have to wait until Friday or the weekend to savour fine seafood at Espresso, the all-day dining venue at InterContinental Bangkok, anymore. Now its famous Premium Seafood Dinner Buffet starts earlier — from Wednesday to Sunday — in case you need a mid-week celebration or pure indulgence.

data.title: Elderly driver gets into GPS jam
data.description: An 83-year-old driver following GPS drove her car onto a U-turn bridge designated for motorcycles only and became stuck, unable to reverse back down and causing a stir in Samut Sakhon on Thursday.

data.title: Tempest in a go-kart as engine debate turns mean
data.description: Children have been caught in the crosshairs of a controversy that arose after a go-karting race in Chon Buri, prompting the body that governs the sport to urge those making comments to leave the young racers out of it.

data.title: S.Pellegrino Young Chef Academy announces Asia regional final in Bangkok
data.description: S.Pellegrino Young Chef Academy has announced that the Asia regional final of its 2026-27 competition will take place on Oct 20 at Le Cordon Bleu Dusit Culinary Arts School in Bangkok.

data.title: 76 deaths attributed to floods since mid-September
data.description: Seventy-six people have died across Thailand since mid-September because of flooding, including 25 in Prachin Buri province alone, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: School roof collapse kills 28 people in Pakistan
data.description: PESHAWAR, Pakistan - Twenty-seven pupils and a teacher were killed on Thursday after a roof collapsed at a school in the northwest Pakistani city of Peshawar, a hospital official said.

data.title: Orange skies in Indonesia as haze crisis spreads
data.description: PALANGKARAYA, Indonesia - Thick haze turned the skies in this Central Kalimantan city apocalyptic shades of yellow and orange on Thursday, reducing visibility to a few dozen metres as wildfires cause a regional air pollution crisis.

data.title: Pope has ‘good night’ in hospital, Vatican says
data.description: ROME - Pope Leo XIV had a “good night” in hospital and has eaten breakfast as he recovers from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said Thursday.
